headline: Turkish manufacturing PMI signals fastest contraction since June in October
summary: Manufacturing activity in Türkiye contracted at its fastest pace since June in October, driven lower by declines in output and new orders according to PMI data.
why: PMI surveys offer timely insight into industrial activity and monetary tightening transmission in emerging markets such as Türkiye.

impacts.name: Turkey
impacts.why: Turkish industrial momentum slowed as output and new order contractions worsened.
